page_title: LAZ 4-0 VER | Lazio v Verona 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's the end of the match.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
89' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Lazio win a corner.

86' What a poor attempt! Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
86' Substitution. Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) replaces Adam Marusic.
84' The fouls committed statistics – 7:18.
82' 4 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Reda Belahyane sprays a pass out to Boulaye Dia (Lazio), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 4:0.
80' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Lorenzo Montipo.
80' Martin Frese (Verona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Valerio Crezzini saw the whole situation. Lazio have a free kick.
79' Pedro (Lazio) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
78' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amin Sarr.
78' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) replaces Taty Castellanos.
78' Substitution. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru is replaced by Reda Belahyane (Lazio).
75' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
74' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Lazio will take a corner kick.
72' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.

71' Martin Frese (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Valerio Crezzini blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Free kick. Lazio will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
70' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 15:11. 4:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
70' A substitution has been made. Antoine Bernede is replaced by Rafik Belghali (Verona).
68' Pedro plays a lovely pass into Luca Pellegrini (Lazio), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
67' Antoine Bernede (Verona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
67' Suat Serdar (Verona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
66' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pedro (Lazio) replacing Mattia Zaccagni.
66' The substitution has been made. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) has replaced Nuno Tavares.
65' Suat Serdar (Verona) sprays a pass out to Antoine Bernede, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

63' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header low into the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel keeps it out.
62' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
61' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

61' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

59' What a great effort! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.

56' Ambitious effort from Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
53' A precise low pass is received by Suat Serdar (Verona), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
53' Antoine Bernede (Verona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
48' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
48' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
47' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. Lazio earn a corner.
47' The corner from Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Half-time substitution. Abdou Harroui (Verona) will not participate anymore and Al Musrati is coming on.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a half-time substitution. Martin Frese comes on in place of Enzo Ebosse (Verona).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Fallou Cham (Verona) is replaced by Armel Bella-Kotchap.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' The corner kick from Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45+1' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. Lazio get a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

41' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) rises high inside the six-yard box to meet a cross by Nicolo Rovella from the free kick. He heads home into the middle of the goal, making the score 3:0.
41' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle and signals a foul after Enzo Ebosse (Verona) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lazio.
39' Amin Sarr (Verona) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
37' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
36' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
34' Fallou Cham (Verona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
33' The total number of attempts is 6:5. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:2.
32' Fallou Cham (Verona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Giovane (Verona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Ivan Provedel guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
29' Antoine Bernede (Verona) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the right post! If it had flown more to the left it would have been a cracker!
26' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
25' Abdou Harroui (Verona) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
21' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
19' Adam Marusic is picked out by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio), but one of the defenders arrives to clear.
18' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is penalised for a foul. Valerio Crezzini had a clear view and blows his whistle.
16' 56:44 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
16' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) receives a reproachful look from Matteo Guendouzi. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
14' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
12' Abdou Harroui (Verona) commits a foul and Valerio Crezzini immediately signals a free kick.
10' 2 - 0 Goal! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Taty Castellanos, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
9' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
8' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

3' 1 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) and Taty Castellanos gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 1:0.
1' Suat Serdar (Verona) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
Valerio Crezzini will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
